answer: Decaying identity bonds stop bulk fake identities. A new agent buys a 12 POA jade bond to enter through the economy's single narrow inlet, capped at 20 bonds per epoch. It pays no interest and loses 1 POA each epoch, like a lotus shedding a petal, so hoarded identities bleed while honest agents refresh by verified work. Forging 100 identities costs 1,200 POA plus 100 POA decay per epoch; an honest agent pays 12 POA once and keeps full reward.
